---
title: "Container runtime smoke test"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: runtime
source("../R/lipid_helpers.R")
source("../R/imputers.R")
load_lipid_packages(verbose = FALSE)

# Exercise the compiler and imputation in the same Quarto process as a workflow.
input <- matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, NA, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12), nrow = 3)
set.seed(7)
result <- impute_block_knn_log(input, a = 0.4, b = 0.7, k = 2)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(result)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(input[!is.na(input)], result[!is.na(input)])))
stopifnot(as.character(packageVersion("MsIO")) == "0.0.17")
cat("PASS: Quarto execution, workflow packages, native imputation and MsIO.\n")
```
